steps.label: What enterocoelom is
steps.why: Entero means gut, so the name itself records where this coelom comes from, and that is the one fact separating it from a schizocoelom.
common_mistakes: Confusing it with schizocoelom. A schizocoelom appears as a split in a solid block of mesoderm; an enterocoelom buds off the gut.
steps.memory_tip: Entero means gut: the coelom starts as a pouch of the embryonic gut.
steps.margin_note: One sentence naming the archenteron. Do not describe the whole of development.

steps.label: The enterocoelomate phyla
steps.why: The three enterocoelomate phyla are exactly the three deuterostome phyla, so one list serves two different questions.
common_mistakes: Adding Annelida or Arthropoda. Those are schizocoelomates.
steps.memory_tip: The three deuterostome phyla are the three enterocoelomate phyla — one list, two questions.
steps.margin_note: Three names in a box. Nothing else is needed for this mark.
lines: These three phyla are the enterocoelomates.
